scenario.description: Maya keeps an heirloom quilt that belonged to her grandmother and must make the final call about its public display, preservation, exhibit dates, and opening arrangements, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has an heirloom patchwork quilt made by their grandmother, and Maya currently keeps it at her home.
shared_context.S2: The quilt is in good enough condition for careful handling and is approximately 175 centimeters by 115 centimeters.
shared_context.S3: The family is planning a small gathering in October to remember their grandmother and share family stories.
shared_context.S4: Maya is responsible for deciding how the quilt will be handled and where it will be shown.
shared_context.S5: During the family's regular Sunday planning call, Maya goes around the group and asks each person for anything that should shape the plan before she settles it.

PF1.text: A textile conservator emailed Jordan a recommendation this week: the quilt should not be washed, should be supported by a flat archival mount, and should be covered with UV-filtering acrylic. Jordan has not passed the recommendation to the family yet.

PF2.text: Leah found a handwritten note from their grandmother saying that the quilt should be displayed at the Oak Street Library reading room rather than sold or kept permanently in storage. Leah has not shown the note to Maya yet.

PF3.text: The Oak Street Library curator confirmed to Ravi that the reading room can accept the quilt from 2026-10-03 through 2026-10-24 and has a wall panel measuring 180 centimeters by 120 centimeters. Ravi has not shared that confirmation with the family yet.

PF4.text: Nina already promised Maya that she will install the hanging hardware and give a short family-history talk at the exhibit opening on 2026-10-10 at 14:00. The promise has not been added to the family's plan.

acceptance_conditions: The quilt must be assigned to the Oak Street Library reading room.
The quilt must not be washed.
The quilt must use a flat archival mount.
The quilt must be protected with UV-filtering acrylic.
The exhibit must run from 2026-10-03 through 2026-10-24.
The opening must be scheduled for 2026-10-10 at 14:00.
The settlement must record all three conservation recommendations across its cleaning, mounting, and protective-cover decisions and cite PF1.
The settlement must use the curator-confirmed exhibit dates and cite PF3.
A commitment must assign Nina both the hanging-hardware installation and the 2026-10-10 at 14:00 family-history talk.
Leah's grandmother's note must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['display_location'] == 'Oak Street Library reading room' or decisions['display_location'] == 'oak_street_library_reading_room'
content_checks.C7: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and ('No washing' in decisions['cleaning_method'] or 'no washing' in decisions['cleaning_method']) and ('Flat archival mount' in decisions['mounting_method'] or 'flat archival mount' in decisions['mounting_method']) and ('UV-filtering acrylic' in decisions['protective_cover'] or 'UV filtering acrylic' in decisions['protective_cover'])
content_checks.C8: 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and (decisions['exhibit_start'] == '2026-10-03' or decisions['exhibit_start'] == 'October 3, 2026' or decisions['exhibit_start'] == 'October 3rd, 2026' or decisions['exhibit_start'] == 'October 3rd') and (decisions['exhibit_end'] == '2026-10-24' or decisions['exhibit_end'] == 'October 24, 2026' or decisions['exhibit_end'] == 'October 24th, 2026' or decisions['exhibit_end'] == 'October 24th')
content_checks.C9: (decisions['opening_date'] == '2026-10-10' or decisions['opening_date'] == 'October 10, 2026' or decisions['opening_date'] == 'October 10th, 2026' or decisions['opening_date'] == 'October 10th') and (decisions['opening_time'] == '14:00' or decisions['opening_time'] == '2:00 PM' or decisions['opening_time'] == '2 PM') and any(c['target'] == 'Nina' and (c['type'] == 'installation' or c['type'] == 'installation_coordination' or c['type'] == 'hardware_installation' or c['type'] == 'installation_and_opening' or c['type'] == 'opening_program') and 'hanging hardware' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] == 'Nina' and (c['type'] == 'presentation' or c['type'] == 'opening_event' or c['type'] == 'family_history_talk' or c['type'] == 'installation_and_opening' or c['type'] == 'opening_program') and 'family-history talk' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The conservator's recommendation changes the cleaning choice to no washing, the support to a flat archival mount, and the cover to UV-filtering acrylic, which are recorded in the three corresponding decision fields.
The grandmother's note changes the destination to the Oak Street Library reading room and supplies the specific private fact that Maya must cite.
The curator's confirmation changes the exhibit dates to exactly 2026-10-03 through 2026-10-24 and supplies the private fact that must support those dates.
Nina's existing promise changes the opening plan to 2026-10-10 at 14:00 and requires commitments assigning her both the hanging-hardware installation and family-history talk.
